discovery_question: Does visible UV_NO_SYNC necessarily defeat useful dependency-state evidence in real dependency-update CI?
result: No. In this observed case an earlier explicit successful uv sync forms the environment before later no-sync execution.
novelty: state formation and later exercise occur in distinct commands
real counterexample to a global no-sync defeater
negative_result_value: If prior state formation or continuity had failed, the same case would define a fail-closed boundary.
stop_reason: Exact transition, sync result, proposed version, later no-sync execution, and workflow ordering are sufficient for the bounded question. No dynamic reproduction is needed.
